ITEM 1 | Two pieces of golden-brown, breaded or coated food with crumbly, flaky light-tan exterior and darker browned edges; cut ends show a pale yellow-green interior with visible speckles, slightly moist sheen on the cut face; pieces are elongated wedge/strip shapes about 6-7 cm long and 2-3 cm wide each, sitting side by side on a white square plate with a few crumbs scattered nearby | 90

ITEM 2 | Small scattered crumbs and light brown residue on the white plate beside the pieces, with a few dark specks, dry and granular with no sheen | 5
